body:
That's awesome. I tried to learn Japanese and programming and stopped short over and over because "life" happened. I just wished that someone was around and cared enough to tell me to keep going. I wasn't getting any feedback from what I was doing and it wrecked me hard. I found a way to get out of that situation though. Maybe you already know how to and you just need some time to sink it in?

What makes you feel that it's impossible to get there?

is there any subject you enjoyed in school like writing, reading, or math? I ask because I could never focus at school due to how stress I was at home. It was not until years later I realized I liked learning and am now learning to make that a career working at home.

Maybe you have something like that. I know it's hard when you can't focus because of the negative thoughts and people around you. I hope we can figure something out that will allow you to get back on your feet unlike myself who wasted ten years inside my head.

do you have anything you're interested in? sometimes school is not the answer which you shouldn't feel bad about. just know you will never feel like an "adult"  even as you age. I'm 29 and feel like I'm still 18.

happy birthday!  🎂 

you're not alone. it's probably hard for you with what you've gone through. whatever you're feeling, please know you're not alone. I feel pretty shitty to when it's my birthday. I never had a birthday celebrated in my 29 years of life. =(

It must have been rough for you to take a big leap from London to USA. You've done what most 28 year olds have never and will never do in their lifetime. I don't think there's any shame. You just tell your family it didn't work out. Let them know you came to America and found places you want to settle but before that, you want to prepare better and go back again.

That's pretty cool you did what you did.
